scope: source component + private FS, injected local responses; not native UI/auth/DB/E2E

checks.name: original manual resync dispatches legacy full send and full render
manual unknown keeps original backup and does not send full profile or claim completion
manual confirmed pending and empty pending use different truthful notices
manual double click and later same-profile edit do not overwrite or emit old completion
manual profile replacement during load prevents adopting old rows or feedback
invalid users target and B delete operation leave pending untouched and send nothing
matching payload with 500 status cannot be confirmed
corrupt pending retry returns failure so manual journey cannot infer empty successful queue
